title: Dancing Ballerinas in Space
description: A person sees two ballerinas dancing together in the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. One ballerina in a green dress stands on one leg holding a broom that shoots sparks while the other in a pink dress does a split on a colorful tiled floor with a small green dragon beside her holding a glowing orb.
prompt: Two ballerinas dance together in a swirling cosmic vortex. The upper ballerina wears a green sparkly dress and balances on one leg while holding a broom that shoots sparks. The lower ballerina in a pink tutu does a split on a colorful tiled floor. A small green dragon sits beside her holding a glowing orb. A blue and orange cat and a green elephant float in the swirling purple orange and teal space filled with stars planets and colorful orbs.
